description: Sri Lanka Customs - Customs Notification No. 1/2015 - Appointed Bonded Warehouses
reasoning: This gazette notification establishes regulatory procedures for bonded warehouses under the Customs Ordinance. It is a statutory instrument issued by the Director General of Customs with ministerial approval, creating a regulatory framework for the warehousing of goods without duty payment. The content focuses on legal/regulatory compliance requirements rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
